scope: Applies to all37 future actions, including the29 immutable historical records. No source assets, templates, plans or productive target outputs supplied; every predicate must be independently established before future use.

recipes.INPUT: Retain independently valid owned NONEMPTY source audio, source bytes/format and selected clip/region, applicable accessible command and known admitted state. Input annotations are input truth only, never detector expected notes.
recipes.PLANS: Independently corroborate the valid nonempty beat-resolution/transient/Warp Marker slice plans, one129-region overlimit plan and separate below-limit plans reached by each recovery. Never infer plan validity/count from the output being tested.
recipes.PRODUCTIVE: Before preview, timing, processing, exclusion or no-effect contrast, genuinely observe NONEMPTY generated notes; separately establish the instrument/effect actually receives them and makes an independently nonzero contribution through active nonmuted output. An enabled flag, nominal mapping or mere clip existence is insufficient. A missing baseline yields U/unexecuted, never pass; no promise arbitrary conversion input produces notes.
recipes.WARP: Independently establish genuine nonidentity Warp timing and distinguishable nonzero slices with productive instrument/output before any timing contrast; hold source region/plan/preset fixed, reset to matched copies between explicit Preserve warped timing On and Off.
recipes.FACTORY-SLICING: Retain exact compatible UNMODIFIED factory slicing-template bytes and separately establish documented envelope/loop/crossfade associations and genuinely active nondegenerate mapped controls across included Simplers. A custom template never proves a factory association. No specific template identity or control curve is supplied.
recipes.FACTORY-CONVERSION: Before assuming a supplied piano/synth Instrument Rack or Synth to Piano macro in old ATM015/016 or any new conversion preview/replacement action, independently establish the matched factory/no-custom Harmony or Melody conversion-default history. F4 input validity alone is insufficient. DEV:B134–139 permits custom single instruments and other default histories; saving/folder/winner laws are not adopted here.
recipes.REPLACEMENT: Independently admit an existing supported device-replacement route and compatible replacement instrument, with productive independently nonzero output before the contrast. The conversion chapter permits replacement but specifies no generic gesture; no new route is invented.
recipes.EFFECT: Start from an actual successful nonempty sliced Rack with two actual slice chains and distinguishable source contributions. Independently admit chain multiselection, the intended supported effect, genuinely active nonzero processing and nonmuted wet/output before any audio contrast; placement availability alone never proves processing.
